definitions.explanation: A general term for laws, regulations, and government orders. Encompasses statutes ({法律|ほうりつ}), cabinet orders ({政令|せいれい}), ministerial ordinances ({省令|しょうれい}), and local ordinances ({条例|じょうれい}).

examples.japanese: {法令|ほうれい}を{遵守|じゅんしゅ}する。
examples.english: To comply with laws and regulations.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{法令|ほうれい}が{来月|らいげつ}から{施行|しこう}される。
examples.english: A new ordinance will go into effect starting next month.

examples.japanese: {関連|かんれん}{法令|ほうれい}をすべて{確認|かくにん}してから{手続|てつづ}きを{進|すす}めてください。
examples.english: Please check all related laws and regulations before proceeding with the procedure.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, umbrella term covering all types of legal rules issued by government authorities. More inclusive than {法律|ほうりつ} (law enacted by the Diet), which refers specifically to statutes. {法令|ほうれい} includes statutes, orders, and regulations at all levels of government.

Commonly seen in official documents, business compliance contexts, and news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {法令|ほうれい}{遵守|じゅんしゅ}: legal compliance
- {法令|ほうれい}{違反|いはん}: violation of a law/regulation
- {関連|かんれん}{法令|ほうれい}: related laws and regulations
- {法令|ほうれい}を{改正|かいせい}する: to amend a law
- {法令|ほうれい}に{基|もと}づく: based on law
